security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob: http://127.0.0.1:*; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; script-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Open-source resin slicer and printer manager
bundle.longDescription: OpenResin slices 3D models for MSLA resin printers, sends files over the local network and shows the printer camera. It works offline and never contacts any cloud service.
